General Intent: Edit the image to evoke the thrilling excitement of a scientific discovery. 
Editing Steps: Replace the large gravestone and its base with a partially excavated, large dinosaur fossil (like a T-Rex skull) emerging from the earth. Replace the smaller, flat gravestone with a set of paleontologist's tools, such as brushes and a small pickaxe, laid out on a canvas sheet. Replace the toy dinosaur with a field journal lying open next to the tools. Remove the dead leaves, making the surrounding dirt and grass look like an active dig site under bright, direct sunlight.
